question.text: A <math><mn>60</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math> electric motor lifts an elevator having a maximum total load capacity of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2000</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo>.</mo></math> If the frictional force on the elevator is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4000</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mo>,</mo></math> the speed of the elevator at full load is close to : <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>HP</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>746</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>g</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>
